response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with 15+ years of engineering experience, including genuine low-latency distributed-systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby micro-services at millions of req/s) and some exposure to fintech-adjacent products (RIDE Capital) and early agentic tooling (MCP code generators at re:cinq). However, the role is an executive CTO position, and the resume shows no evidence of engineering leadership at scale — no team management, no hiring or scaling of 10→30+ organizations, no board-level communication, and no governance of outsourced delivery partners. Critically, there is no demonstrated production multi-agent AI system ownership, no LLM evaluation/fine-tuning or real-time inference architecture, and no experience operating AI in regulated financial environments. The gap between a Staff/Senior IC profile and a venture-backed scale-up CTO mandate is too large to bridge in this hiring context.
strengths: Deep backend and distributed-systems experience, including high-throughput low-latency microservices
Broad polyglot full-stack range plus founder experience with an event-driven, Kubernetes-deployed platform
Early hands-on exposure to agentic AI infrastructure (MCP tooling) and strong testing/craftsmanship culture
concerns: No people-management or engineering-organization scaling track record required for a CTO role
No production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation, or real-time inference architecture experience
Minimal fintech-infrastructure depth (credit, liquidity, compliance) and no regulated-AI operating history
